description:
Shows how much each person on the project works per day, week or month and who is over-allocated: for each person the load as a percentage of their availability (personal calendar x max units), the tasks causing it and the date ranges above 100%.
The scheduler does not level resources: an over-allocation is solved by moving or reassigning tasks, or by changing assignment units. Read-only.

from.description: First day, YYYY-MM-DD. Default: start of assigned work.

granularity.description: Load columns: day, week (default) or month. Over-allocations are always evaluated per day.

projectId.description: Project id (uuid), as returned by planitude_list_projects.

to.description: Last day, YYYY-MM-DD. Default: end of assigned work.

name: planitude_workload
title: Get team workload
